mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_problem_progress (user_id, problem_id, status, first_submission_id, first_submission_time, last_submission_id, last_submission_time, attempt_count, accepted_count, first_accepted_submission_id, first_accepted_time, create_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, #{progressStatus}, #{submissionId}, #{submissionTime}, #{submissionId}, #{submissionTime}, 1, #{acceptedIncrement}, CASE WHEN #{acceptedIncrement} = 1 THEN #{submissionId} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{acceptedIncrement} = 1 THEN #{submissionTime} ELSE NULL END, #{person}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = CASE WHEN #{acceptedIncrement} = 1 THEN 'SOLVED' ELSE status END, last_submission_id = CASE WHEN #{submissionTime} >= last_submission_time THEN #{submissionId} ELSE last_submission_id END, last_submission_time = GREATEST(last_submission_time, #{submissionTime}), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, accepted_count = accepted_count + #{acceptedIncrement}, first_accepted_submission_id = CASE WHEN first_accepted_submission_id IS NULL AND #{acceptedIncrement} = 1 THEN #{submissionId} ELSE first_accepted_submission_id END, first_accepted_time = CASE WHEN first_accepted_time IS NULL AND #{acceptedIncrement} = 1 THEN #{submissionTime} ELSE first_accepted_time END, update_by = #{person}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
